field_text_formatted.value: Look at where [jsonapi_node_preview] sits in that template: after the #. Browsers never send the fragment to a server, so the address of an unsaved draft stays out of the frontend's access logs, any CDN in front of it, and the Referer of anything the page loads. Scripts on the page can still read it, so keep error tracking and session replay off the preview route.
